title: Endometrium Dissociation with Trypsin
author: Regina Hoo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.72dhqa6
materials: Count live cells using tryphan blue and haematocytometer.

steps.title: Collect retained tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Invert the cell strainer containing the tissue pieces into a new 50 mL tube and add 45 mL PBS using a 1 mL pipette to wash the pieces into the tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge tissue pieces
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 450 g for 5 min (00:05:00); discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of 0.25 % Trypsin/EDTA and incubate for 20 min (00:20:00) at 37 °C while shaking.

steps.title: Add culture medium
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL RPMI supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) to the digestion mixture.

steps.title: Filter digested material
steps.instruction: Slowly filter the suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer, discarding any retained tissue.

steps.title: First wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 500 rcf for 5 min (00:05:00) at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Optional RLB resuspension and RBC lysis
steps.instruction: (optional) Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL RLB mix and incubate for 10 min (00:10:00). Prepare RLB by diluting 10× RLB stock with water. After RBC lysis, add 10 mL PBS and centrifuge at 500 rcf for 5 min (00:05:00).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend sample with 5 mL RLB mix and incubate 10 min.
Dilute 10× RLB stock with water to make RLB.
After RBC lysis, add 10 mL PBS.

steps.title: Resuspend in 1 mL PBS
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell pellet to an Eppendorf tube and resuspend in 1 mL PBS.

steps.title: Second wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 rcf for 5 min (00:05:00) at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 250 µL PBS (adjust final volume according to cell number).

steps.title: Filter cells through snap‑cap tube
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a cell‑strainer snap‑cap tube.

steps.title: Optional freezing of cells
steps.instruction: (optional) Resuspend cells in freezing medium to a concentration of 1 × 10⁷ cells per mL and aliquot into cryogenic storage vials.
